enable_cache_on_model: enable caching on a diffusion model by calling enable_cache with a FasterCacheConfig or PyramidAttentionBroadcastConfig
disable_cache_on_model: disable caching on a diffusion model by calling disable_cache to remove all registered hooks
check_cache_enabled: check if caching is enabled on a model by reading the is_cache_enabled property
reset_stateful_cache: reset stateful cache hooks on a model by calling _reset_stateful_cache with recurse set to true
use_cache_context: use the cache_context context manager to set a named context for cache management on a model
